{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
trial_df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Check for sentinel values in biomarker_baseline
n_sentinel_biomarker = (trial_df['biomarker_baseline'] == 999).sum()

# Check if these rows are otherwise valid
# Look at the distribution of other columns for these rows
sentinel_rows = trial_df[trial_df['biomarker_baseline'] == 999]

# Check if any other columns have sentinel values in these rows
other_sentinels = {}
for col in trial_df.columns:
    if col != 'biomarker_baseline':
        if trial_df[col].dtype == 'object':
            other_sentinels[col] = sentinel_rows[col].isin(['NA', 'N/A', 'null', 'NULL', '']).sum()
        else:
            other_sentinels[col] = sentinel_rows[col].isin([999, -999, 9999, -9999]).sum()

# Filter non-zero
other_sentinels = {k: v for k, v in other_sentinels.items() if v > 0}

# Final count of patients
n_patients = len(trial_df)

# Report
print(f'Number of patients: {n_patients}')
print(f'Rows with biomarker_baseline == 999: {n_sentinel_biomarker}')
print(f'Other sentinel values in these rows: {other_sentinels}')"}
